title: Evidence-Carrying Contracts for Safe Claim Composition in Data Marketplace Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.23276v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data marketplace workflows cross organizational boundaries, where payment, policy presence, or API delivery may be promoted into transaction claims that the evidence does not support. We introduce evidence-carrying claim contracts: a lightweight assume-guarantee semantics declaring assumptions, guarantees, blocking obligations, and evidence dependencies. A conflict-sensitive four-state domain distinguishes supported, refuted, unresolved, and conflicting requirements. Safe composition bounds the transaction claim by the meet of local bounds and blocks full promotion while a critical obligation remains open. We establish local soundness, compositional boundedness, revocation safety, termination, and aggregation-order invariance for finite acyclic workflows. translated_title: 数据市场工作流中用于安全声明组合的证据携带合约
translated_abstract: 数据市场工作流跨越组织边界，其中支付、政策存在性或 API 交付可能被提升为证据并不支持的事务声明。我们引入了证据携带声明合约：一种轻量级的假设-保证语义，用于声明假设、保证、阻塞义务和证据依赖。一个冲突敏感的四状态域用于区分被支持、被反驳、未解决和相互冲突的需求。安全组合通过局部边界的下确界来约束事务声明，并在关键义务仍未完成时阻止声明的完全提升。我们针对有限无环工作流建立了局部可靠性、组合有界性、撤销安全性、终止性以及聚合顺序不变性。一个可执行的一致性测试工具覆盖了全部 4,096 种配置（六个阶段各有四种状态）、18 种变异、六种基本撤销、12 种替代支持场景以及一个八阶段……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“证据携带声明合约”这一轻量级假设-保证语义，通过冲突敏感的四状态域与安全组合规则，确保数据市场工作流中的事务声明只有在证据充分支持时才能被提升，并为有限无环工作流证明了可靠性、有界性、撤销安全性和终止性等关键性质。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces evidence-carrying claim contracts, a lightweight assume-guarantee semantics with a conflict-sensitive four-state domain, ensuring that transaction claims in data marketplace workflows are promoted only when supported by evidence, and establishing local soundness, compositional boundedness, revocation safety, and termination for finite acyclic workflows.
